title: SHAP Explained Simply in 45 Seconds (AI Model Explanations Made Easy)
description:
SHAP (Shapley Additive Explanations) is one of the most powerful ways to understand how AI models make decisions. In this 45-second breakdown, we explain how it comes from game theory, how features act like “players” in a prediction, and how SHAP fairly assigns credit to each one.

You’ll also learn its key strengths, limitations, and why it works best for tabular data—not images. If you’re learning AI, machine learning, or data science, this is a must-know concept for model interpretability.

#AI #MachineLearning #DataScience #ExplainableAI #SHAP #ShapleyValue
